'''March 2001 Minneapolis tournament (13 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 13 March 2001. Nick won it. It is known from Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1893">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-3-13d1893/ moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-3-13], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 13 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-3-13d1893/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' Nick
